testsuite.name: story intake HTTP, privacy, immutable submissions and rollback in isolated MySQL

testcase.name: empty configuration exposes no fabricated categories; only a publisher can publish immutable template versions
an incomplete draft is private and can be restored, deliberately emptied and saved without old-value substitution
listing returns necessary summaries without private answers or submission bodies
publishing a newer category does not silently migrate existing drafts or their questions
submit creates one immutable version and exposes that exact text to the intake operator
intake records a responsible operator without rewriting the submission or implying payment/production approval
idempotency protects a create or save from double creation and refuses changed content under the same key
two concurrent saves with the same version cannot silently overwrite one another
concurrent submission with different keys creates exactly one submitted version
institution membership does not expose another member's private story, even to the institution owner
removing membership immediately denies reads, writes and previously successful idempotent replays
revoked operator grants deny detail, inbox and replay of a previously successful intake
suspended accounts cannot replay an old creation or read previously accessible content
required attachments reject missing files, public URLs and identifiers without an owned ready upload
a valid long story can submit and replay even when the response contains more than 64 KiB of immutable content
client-supplied state, authority and undeclared fields never become accepted story answers
HTTP commands require authentication, an explicit party, idempotency and version headers
HTTP enforces the 64 KiB JSON boundary and returns only fixed validation reasons, never story text
HTTP preserves safe whole-form validation reasons without reflecting private answers or unknown field names
pagination binds signed cursors to user, party, list type and filter
failed audit rolls back creation and its deduplication record so a safe retry creates one draft
failed submission audit rolls back state, immutable version and operation record together
only a current operator can request scoped supplements after actual intake; request replay is stable
supplement draft edits and responses are private and do not overwrite the submitted story
every requested item needs an explicit response; clearing remains empty and never silently closes a request
resubmission freezes a new version, preserves the first, and returns to operations without marking the material approved
multiple supplement rounds retain all published versions and private history stays scoped to the request
concurrent requests, draft saves and submissions each have a single winner
revoked membership and operator grants block supplement reads and old command replay
audit failure rolls back supplement request, private save and resubmission as complete transactions
supplements permit attachment corrections but reject forged states and missing version
private attachments upload, reopen, submit, supplement and retain immutable versions through HTTP
free creation uses the existing publishing authority; unsubmitted files revoke and uncertain uploads recover
missing upload retries repair the same row; unreadable, corrupt and no-longer-editable files do not overwrite
story intake has no order, payment, refund or production side effects
blessing video is a private human-readable request with explicit operator intake, never an automatic generation

testsuite.name: notices and one-way submissions in isolated MySQL

testcase.name: ordinary adult cannot publish by supplying a level; funding alone grants no points
independent review and public projection exclude evidence/contacts
official posts need dedicated operator authority and independent reviewer
three structured artist submission kinds and buyer intent retain concrete person/avatar
old-client new invitation resolves and freezes its public source without changing the retry body
omitting source cannot bypass a withdrawn listing or later review and recipient rechecks
source resolution requires live public consent, halo, hosting and original material rights
ambiguous legacy public sources require an explicit source instead of guessing
already stored source-less invitations retain their historical review and decision rules
pending submissions hidden from recipient; outsider and generic comments cannot bypass
duplicate interest creates one case; no order or chat created
concurrent opposite decisions produce one winner, stale version rejected
deadline failure never creates a customer service case
withdrawal closes unlinked case and blocks later conversion
qualified organization still needs reviewed explicit publishing scope
finance facts cannot be self approved or credited twice using same receipt
case association verifies actual quote, parties, avatar and immutable version
audit failure rolls back case and decision together
private submission file checks ownership, recipient consent and stored bytes
a child or revoked consent cannot be submitted or read as a valid adult artist
MCN may submit only for the specifically delegated person; withdrawal removes access
rule API uses independent approval, rejection and closure; unauthenticated route remains closed
publication loss prevents new replies without changing historical quote snapshot
lists and notifications use current permissions
mixed results commit independently and rejected result survives reopen
same request and lost receipt replay do not repeat assignment; changed payload rejected
parallel retries return one batch and one business mutation
foreign accounts, personal identities, invalid batches and revoked membership

testsuite.name: organization merchandise batch isolated MySQL and HTTP

testcase.name: artist and stock submission retain original independent-review state
price change creates a reviewable new specification without changing listing or old price
MCN assignment reuses booking and current artist delegation
revoked artist authorization hides receipts and prevents replay
